title: Beautiful, and Not
label: ch:ml-beauty
canDo: I can say that something is beautiful, name beauty itself, and deny it.

payoff.summary: From cold: both ends of one quality, and which letter arrives when aaNu follows a word.
payoff.note: Three atoms. THE FIRST DRAFT UNIFIED TWO DIFFERENT PROCESSES -- 'a letter arrives' is false for the anusvara, which already IS the m and only changes how it is written, and true only for bhangi/kutti where a ya is genuinely added between two vowels. It also taught that alla does not weld, read out of ML-C77's single chillu-final example, the one host that cannot show the rule; alla welds exactly as aaNu does and the headword is now ithu sundaramalla. The recall's 'nothing else' was falsified by its own title romanization sundaravum. ithu bhangiyaaNu means THIS IS BEAUTIFUL, not 'this is beauty'. The romanization is bhamgi, since the track reserves the nga letter for nga and writes a medial anusvara with the dotted m, as in kumbham.
